title: 4 n8n workflows that actually work
caption:
4 n8n workflows that actually work

Most people get this wrong. Avoid these:
1️⃣ Start with a template — Community flows or an HTTP webhook — first working run in under 10 minutes.
2️⃣ Drag if/else branches — Merges and conditions on one canvas — flows flat Zaps physically cannot express.
3️⃣ Keep a run log — Every execution stored in its own database — replay any failure, any day, with inputs intact.
4️⃣ Run it yourself — Self-hosted on your server: customer data never leaves, runs stay unlimited at fixed cost.
